SUMMARY: BirdFactory builds procedural birds by assembling a genome (tree of body, wings, tail, legs, feet, head, beak, eyes) via part factories, joining/rigging the parts into a single mesh, applying materials, and grooming feathers/hair. Two variants exist: BirdFactory (ground/duck-like bird, optionally animated with run/idle/swim) and FlyingBirdFactory (flying bird that follows a bezier flight path). The upper-level files define the genome (proportions, part placement, wing extension), hair/feather grooming, and animation drivers; the util/ files implement the generic creature-assembly, rigging, joining, and animation machinery.

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/bird.py
  bird_hair_params(flying): controls feather/hair look
    knobs: length(flying:U(0.01,0.025), ground:U(0.03,0.06)) -> feather length; puff(U(0.03,0.2)) -> feather puffiness; density(70000 fixed) -> hair count; clump_n(10 fixed) -> guide-hair clumping; avoid_features_dist(0.02) -> keep hair off eyes/beak; Combing(U(0.6,1)) -> comb strength; Strand Perlin Mag(U(0,0.003)) -> strand waviness; Tuft Clumping(U(0.5,1)) -> tuft tightness; Root Radius(0.006) -> strand base thickness; Hair Length Pct Min(U(0.5,0.9)) -> length variation; material Roughness(U(0,0.4)), Radial Roughness(U(0.1,0.3)), Random Roughness(U(0,0.2)), IOR(1.55) -> shine/color spread
  duck_genome(mode): ground/duck bird proportions & layout (all sampled with N/U jitter)
    knobs: body_fac var(U(0.3,1)) -> body shape variation; tail rest rot(170°*N) -> tail angle; foot length_rad1_rad2(body_length*0.1) -> foot size; Toe Splay(35°*N) -> toe spread; Toebean Radius(0.03) -> foot pad size; Claw Curl Deg(12°*N) -> claw hook; Toe Curl Scalar(0.34) -> toe bend; leg length(body_length*0.5), rad1(0.09), rad2(0.06) -> leg thickness; leg_coord(N(0.5),N(0.7),N(0.95)) -> leg attach position; extension(flying:U(0.7,1), else U(0.01,0.1)) -> wing spread; wing_len(body_length*0.5*clip_gaussian(1.2,0.7,0.5,2.5)) -> wing size; wing_coord(N(0.7),110/180,0.95) -> wing attach; wing_rot((90,0,90) if ext>0.5 else (90,40,90)) -> folded vs open; eye Radius(N(0.03,0.005)); eye t(U(0.6,0.85)), splay(U(80,110)/180) -> eye position; beak coord(0.75,0,0.5)
  flying_bird_genome(mode): flying bird proportions (slimmer body, wide wings)
    knobs: body_lrr((0.95,0.13,0.18)*N) -> slim body; tail coord(U(0.08,0.15)) / rest rot(180°*N); foot length(body_length*0.2), Toe Splay(8°*N) -> small feet; leg length(body_length*0.5), rad1(0.04), rad2(0.02); Thigh/Shin Rad Fullness -> leg silhouette; leg_coord(N(0.5),N(0.2),N(0.8)); leg shoulder rest rot(0,U(135,175),0); extension(U(0.8,1)) -> wings spread open; wing_len(body_length*clip_gaussian(1.0,0.2,0.6,1.5)*0.8); wing rad1(U(0.08,0.15)); feather_density(U(25,40)) -> feather count on wing; wing_coord(N(0.68),150/180,0.8); eye Radius(N(0.02,0.005)), t(U(0.7,0.85)); head coord(U(0.84,0.85),0,U(1.05,1.15)) / rest pitch(N(18,5))
  apply_bird_materials(bird, obj): maps material slots to part groups (body/feathers, tongue, teeth/claws=bone, eyeball, beak)
  BirdFactory: ground bird entry
    knobs: animation_mode(None/"run"/"idle"/"swim") -> animation type; body_material (weighted_sample from material_assignments.bird, seeded) -> plumage material; idle wing_mag(U(0,0.3)) -> idle wing motion; swim mag_deg(U(0,30)), freq(U(0.5,2)) -> tail wiggle; hair flag -> feathers on/off
  FlyingBirdFactory: flying bird entry
    knobs: max_expected_radius(1), max_distance(40) -> LOD/cull; altitude(("uniform",15,30)) -> flight height; policy speed(U(7,15)), step_range((5,40)), yaw_dist(("normal",0,15)) -> flight path shape; placeholder size(cube 3); animation_mode(None/"idle"); idle foot_motion_chance(1.0), body_mag(0.0), head_benddown(0)

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/animation/idle.py
  idle_body_noise_drivers(): procedural idle noise
    knobs: foot_motion_chance(0.2 default) -> foot fidget frequency; head_benddown(1.0) -> head droop; body_mag/wing_mag(1.0) -> body/wing sway scale; per-target mag & freq constants (body 0.025/0.015, foot 0.07/0.04, head 0.07/0.03/0.2, wingtip 0.1/0.2 freq U(0.6,4)) -> amplitude/speed of each part's idle motion; freq_scalar/mag_scalar(N(1,0.15)) -> global tempo/amplitude jitter
  snap_iks_to_floor(minweight=0.7): plants feet on terrain via bvh raycast

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/animation/run_cycle.py
  animate_run(): walk/run gait
    knobs: stride_length(0.7*clip_gaussian(0.4,0.3,0.3,0.6)*dim_x); spread(clip_gaussian(0.15,0.1,0,0.5)); stride_height(U(0.15,0.4)); body_height(stride_height*clip_gaussian(0.6,0.4,0.3,1.2)); flap_height(U(0.3,1)); squash_gait_pct(0.1); steps_per_sec(1) -> gait size/tempo
  foot_path/body_path: NURBS gait curves (shape via length/height/upturn/down_stroke)
  animate_wiggle_bones / animate_running_front/back_leg: bone-driver based motion (mag_deg, freq, wavelength)
  follow_path/follow_gait_path/follow_body_path: attach targets to motion curves

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/animation/driver_wiggle.py
  animate_wiggle_bones(): sinusoidal bone rotation (mag_deg, freq flaps/sec, wavelength) -> used for swim tail wiggle

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/hair.py
  configure_hair(): builds feather/hair particle→curve system and grooming geonodes; re-parameterizes density (count = surface_area * density) and clump count; assigns hair BSDF material
  nodegroup_hair_grooming / nodegroup_decode_noise: geometry-node grooming graph (driven by bird_hair_params grooming dict)

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/joining.py
  join_and_rig_parts(): joins body parts, computes rig, remeshes, applies materials
    knobs: face_size / min_remesh_size(0.01) -> mesh resolution; adapt_mode("remesh"); smooth_joins(True), smooth_attrs(False); rig_before_subdiv(False); roll("GLOBAL_POS_Y"); remove_doubles thresholds(0.01/0.001)
  compute_joining_effects(): bevel/smooth bridges between parts (bridge_rad/smooth_rad from genome attachments)

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/creature.py
  genome_to_creature(): instantiates part factories, attaches per genome tree, writes local/global attributes
  attach/apply_attach_transform/raycast_surface: place child parts on parent surface (coord u,v,rad + rotation_basis global/normal/tangent)
  PartFactory/Part: base classes for all body parts

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/genome.py
  Joint(rest/pose/bounds/stiffness/stretch): per-attachment pose & IK limits
  Attachment(coord/joint/bridge/side/rotation_basis/bridge_rad/smooth_rad): how parts connect
  part()/attach(): tree-building sugar
  interp_* / lerp helpers: genome interpolation (blend two birds)

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/rigging.py
  creature_rig(): builds armature bones from part skeletons, IK targets, constraints
    knobs: shoulder_auto_stiffness(0.85); trim_bounds_child_margin(0.15); connector_collapse_margin_radpct(0.5); roll mode
  create_ragdoll(): physics rig (min_col_length=0.1, col_joint_margin=0.2, col_radius=0.07, mass=5)

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/creature_util.py
  offset_center(): centers/floors the creature; euler/polar_skeleton/interp_dict helpers

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/tree.py
  Tree + iter/map/fold/zip utilities used to walk the genome part tree

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/util/join_smoothing.py
  compute_intersection_curve/create_bevel_connection/smooth_around_line: geometry for smooth part joins

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/parts/__init__.py
  imports part modules (beak, body, wings, foot, leg, head, eye, tail, generic_nurbs, etc.) referenced by the genomes; swap/add part factories here

FILE: assets/objects/creatures/__init__.py
  package exports (BirdFactory, FlyingBirdFactory among all creature factories)

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  assets/composition/material_assignments.py -> weighted material choices (material_assignments.bird) for plumage
  assets/materials/creature/__init__.py -> creature materials (tongue, bone, eyeball, beak) used by apply_bird_materials
  assets/materials/* -> shared shader/material node libraries
  assets/utils/nodegroups/hair.py -> reusable hair geometry-node groups (comb, clump, strand noise) used by grooming
  assets/utils/geometry/lofting.py, curve.py, __init__.py -> skeleton/tangent & NURBS geometry helpers
  assets/utils/object.py -> object creation/mesh utilities
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base class
  core/placement/animation_policy.py -> AnimPolicyRandomForwardWalk + bezier flight-path creation
  core/placement/detail.py -> adaptive mesh resolution / remeshing
